verdict.rationale: Datadog is a SaaS observability platform, so an official MCP server is a fair axis. A first-party 'Datadog MCP Server' docs page exists, and a probe independently confirms an official MCP server documented at docs.datadoghq.com/mcp_server/. The evidence is mostly titles and confirmation of existence, with little detail on how an agent actually connects. Missing for 10: detail on exposed tools and capabilities, authentication and setup steps for agent clients, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent connections working in practice.
